items.title: Census the Names a Function Reads Before You Extract It
items.description:
Most extractions do not fail in review. They fail two weeks later, when a test hits a module global nobody remembered. The repair costs more than the extraction did.

So start with a count, not a diff. Census every name the target function reads. Then move exactly that much and no more.
